title: About Blessing-Curse Terrain Seam
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 310 recent saved-signal files and 266 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around blessing/curse; preliminary dimensional drifella composer & breeder by Evil Biscuit | Verse and @cairoasmith: There's a common misconception that Brutalist buildings were unpainted, but thanks..., plus 7 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Blessing-Curse Terrain Seam: A painted-diorama threshold in a severe gallery-landscape field, game-space surface composition, browserless media shrine plate grammar. One oversized terrain seam divides pale repaired blessing from darker bruised curse; shallow map strata cast thin shadows. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against raised diagonal torn plaster seam, pale scraped concrete field, and dark rough memory-stain field.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
